profile.noStreak_one: Train {{count}} day this week to start a streak.
profile.noStreak_other: Train {{count}} days this week to start a streak.
profile.freezeHelp: A missed week is bridged automatically, up to this many per month, so one off week doesn't end your streak.

exercises.inUse: This exercise has logged sets and can't be deleted.

gyms.name: Gym name
gyms.confirmDelete: Delete this gym? Its notes are kept.

routines.name: Routine name
routines.none: No routines yet. Create one to get started.

programs.name: Program name
programs.startHelp: Week 1 is the week containing this date. The program repeats after the last week.
programs.rotationHelp: The next routine is suggested after each finished workout, whatever the day. Each routine can appear once.

today.title: Today's workout
today.notStarted: Your program starts the week of {{date}}.

summary.title: Workout complete
summary.imageHelp: Shows the workout only: no gym, notes or body data.

forgotten.title: Still working out?
forgotten.body: No set logged for 2 hours. Finish at your last set ({{time}}) or keep going?
forgotten.notification: No set logged for 2 hours. Open the app to finish your workout.
forgotten.bodyEmpty: No set was logged in this workout, and it has been open for over 2 hours. Discard it or keep going?

history.title: History
history.pickDay: Tap a day to see its workouts.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.exactBody: Android only fires timers on time if BliskFit may schedule exact alarms. Without it, the rest-over alert can arrive late.
reminders.trainHelp: You get a reminder on these days, except on a day you've already trained.
reminders.webNote: In the browser reminders only fire while the app is open; the Android app delivers them reliably.
reminders.trainBody: Your workout is waiting in BliskFit.

detail.confirmDelete: Delete this workout and all its sets? This can't be undone.

records.title: Records
records.none: No records yet. Log this exercise to start tracking them.

gymplan.title: Gym visits
gymplan.summaryDay_one: Visit plan: {{count}} visit, periods start on day {{day}}
gymplan.summaryDay_other: Visit plan: {{count}} visits, periods start on day {{day}}
gymplan.help: Each day you finish a workout at this gym counts as one visit, however many workouts you do that day. Days past the end of a short month use its last day.
gymplan.pace_every_one: Go most days to use them all.
gymplan.pace_every_other: About every {{count}} days to use them all.
gymplan.pace_daily: Every remaining day to use them all.
gymplan.editHelp: Tap a day to count it or not. Days with a workout count on their own: add a day you forgot to log, or remove one the gym didn't count.

stats.title: Stats
stats.pinsFull: You can pin up to {{count}} stats. Unpin one first.
stats.vsLastWeek: Compared with the whole of last week.
stats.noneUnder: Every muscle group is at {{target}}+ sets a week.
stats.underHelp: Average weekly sets over the last {{weeks}} weeks, against a target of {{target}}.
stats.noExerciseHistory: Finish a workout to see exercise charts here.
stats.plateau: Plateau: no new best estimated 1RM in your last {{count}} sessions.
stats.musclesHelp: Primary muscles get full credit for a set, secondary muscles half. The marker shows your target of {{count}} sets a week. Tap a group to see its muscles.
stats.pushPullHelp: Push: chest, shoulders, triceps. Pull: back, biceps. Counted from the muscles each exercise works.
stats.compareNeedTwo: Add at least two photos with the same tag to compare them.
stats.trendHelp: The line is a smoothed trend; the dots are your weigh-ins.
stats.gymsNone: No exercise has been done at two or more gyms yet.
stats.gymHelp: Best set is the one with the highest estimated 1RM. Workouts without a gym are left out.
stats.emptyPins: Finish a workout and your stats show up here.
stats.noPins: Nothing pinned yet. Pin stats with the ☆ in the Stats panel.

body.title: Body log
body.dayFull: That day already has {{count}} photos. Delete one of that day's photos below first.
body.storage: {{count}} photos use {{mb}} MB on this device.

backup.title: Backup and data
backup.backupHelp: Saves everything (workouts, routines, exercises, body log, progress photos and settings) in one file. Keep it somewhere off this phone, such as Google Drive.
backup.restoreHelp: Replaces all data on this device with the contents of a backup file.
backup.confirmRestore: Restore the backup from {{date}}? It has {{workouts}} workouts, {{routines}} routines and {{photos}} photos. Everything currently on this device will be replaced.
backup.csvHelp: Every logged set of your finished workouts, for spreadsheets. It can't be restored; use a backup for that.
backup.persistHelp: The browser may clear this app's data when the phone runs low on space. Install the app or save backups regularly.

error.invalid: That file isn't a BliskFit backup.
error.newer: This backup was made by a newer version of the app. Update the app first.
error.failed: Something went wrong. Nothing was changed.

backup.autoHelp: Automatic backups, saved in the app before each update:

share.importTitle: Add a shared routine or program
share.importHelp: Open a link someone sent you, or choose a routine or program file they shared.
share.missing_one: {{count}} exercise isn't available in this version of the app and will be left out.
share.missing_other: {{count}} exercises aren't available in this version of the app and will be left out.
share.addRoutineHelp: It's added as a new routine; your own routines aren't changed.
share.addProgramHelp: Its routines are added as new ones. The program isn't made active; week 1 starts this week.

error.invalid: That isn't a valid shared routine or program.
error.newer: This was shared from a newer version of the app. Update the app first.
error.backup: That's a full backup. Restore it from Settings → Backup and data.

share.inAppHelp: Using the Android app? It keeps its own data, so add it there:

updates.title: App updates
updates.backupFailed: Couldn't save the automatic backup. Update anyway?
updates.help: Updating saves an automatic backup first, then downloads the new version; Android asks you to confirm the install. Your data stays.
updates.webHelp: The web version updates itself: when a new version is out you'll see an “Update available” bar.

drive.title: Google Drive
drive.help: Back up automatically to your own Google Drive, in a “BliskFit backups” folder. BliskFit can only see the files it creates there, nothing else in your Drive.
drive.autoHelp: A backup is saved after every workout and at least once a day when you open the app; the newest 7 are kept.
drive.confirmDisconnect: Stop backing up to Google Drive? The backups already there stay in your Drive.
drive.confirmDelete: Delete the backup from {{date}} from your Drive?
drive.failed: Couldn't reach Google Drive. Check your connection and try again.

problem.signIn: The last automatic backup needs you to sign in again: tap “Back up now”.
problem.failed: The last automatic backup didn't go through. It will try again; or tap “Back up now”.

drive.popupBlocked: Your browser blocked Google’s sign-in window. Allow pop-ups for this site and try again.

equipmentSettings.title: Equipment
equipmentSettings.hint: New sets are typed in this unit. Each set keeps the unit it was typed in, so earlier workouts never change; numbers already typed in the running workout keep their value. A single set can be switched in its details.
equipmentSettings.hintPlates: New sets are typed in this unit and always include the bar. Each set keeps the unit it was typed in, so earlier workouts never change; numbers already typed in the running workout keep their value. Leave the bar empty for the usual one; 0 for a machine with no bar.

plates.title: Plates
plates.notExact: {{target}} can't be loaded with these plates; closest below is {{total}}.
